title: First revelation
lines: - Place: Cave of Hira, Jabal an-Nur, near Makkah.
- Age of the Prophet (PBUH): about 40 (610 CE).
- Verses: the opening of Surah Al-Alaq.

title: Compilation of the Quran
lines: | Written in the Prophet's lifetime | scribes, led by Zayd ibn Thabit (RA)
| One copy after Yamamah | Abu Bakr (RA), on Umar's (RA) advice
| Copy kept | Abu Bakr, Umar, then Hafsa (RA)
| Standard copies sent out | Uthman (RA), Jami' al-Quran

title: Revealed books
lines: - 25 prophets are named in the Quran.

title: Prophets and their peoples
lines: | Nuh (AS) | the ark and the flood
| Salih (AS) | people of Thamud, the she-camel

title: Hadith terms
lines: | Hadith Qudsi | meaning from Allah in the Prophet's words
| Sahih, hasan, da'if, mawdu' | sound, good, weak, fabricated

title: The six collections
lines: | Sahih al-Bukhari | Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari
- Not in the six: Muwatta (Imam Malik), Musnad (Imam Ahmad).

title: Articles of faith
lines: ! Shirk, associating partners with Allah, is the gravest sin.

title: Angels and duties
lines: | Israfil | trumpet on the Last Day
| Munkar and Nakir | questioning in the grave

title: Daily prayers
lines: - Total 17. Jumu'ah (2) replaces Zuhr on Friday.
- Salah made obligatory at the Mi'raj.

title: Zakat and fasting
lines: - Zakat: 2.5 % of savings above the nisab, held for one lunar year.
- Zakat and Ramadan fasting made obligatory in 2 AH.
- Eight groups may receive zakat (Surah At-Tawbah).
- Sadaqat al-Fitr: paid before the Eid al-Fitr prayer.

title: Days of Hajj
lines: | 10th | Jamarat, sacrifice, hair cut, tawaf; Eid al-Adha
- Sa'i: Safa to Marwah, seven times, recalling Hajar (AS).

title: Seerah: Makkah
lines: | about 570 CE | birth, Year of the Elephant

title: Caves and mosques
lines: - Cave of Thawr: shelter during the Hijrah.
- Masjid al-Qiblatayn: qibla changed to the Kaaba.
- The Prophet (PBUH) is buried in the room of Aisha (RA).

title: Rightly Guided Caliphs
lines: - Order A-U-U-A: Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali. The two U names sit in the middle, Umar before Uthman.

title: Caliphs: achievements
lines: - Abu Bakr (RA): Riddah wars, Yamamah, Quran in one copy.
- Umar (RA): Hijri calendar, diwan, Jerusalem, Yarmuk, Qadisiyyah.
- Uthman (RA): standard Quran copies, first navy.
